text:
maya_cs: Heads-up — Mariner Analytics has a partner demo Tue 09:30 SGT. They hit 429s in last run. Request: temporary APAC egress allowlist + short burst (~650 QPS) for 5h. Need X-Session-ID header passthrough. Who can own?

theo_netops: Please post CIDRs and exact UTC window. Edge-level allowlist + header passthrough?

maya_cs: CIDRs (redacted): 198.51.100.99/32, 203.0.113.10/31. Window: 2026-06-12 01:30 -> 06:30 UTC (09:30 -> 14:30 SGT). Edge-level + header required. Project: mariner-prod. Note: customer listed demo stability as renewal hinge.

vlad_eng: I can create ephemeral policy. Plan: QPS steady=80, burst=650, auto-expire at 06:30 UTC, tag pilot-mariner, billing tag, canary to apac-edge-1 for 12m. Add alert to #eng-sre for 429>0.75%.

rachel_ops: Please include cost-tag and export pilot metrics to billing-export so finance can see token delta. Also add runbook step for manual rollback.

vlad_eng: CLI snippet (infra host):

```
redwoodctl policies create \
  --name mariner-apac-demo-2026-06-12 \
  --project mariner-prod \
  --region apac \
  --cidrs 198.51.100.99/32,203.0.113.10/31 \
  --header-forward X-Session-ID \
  --qps 80 --burst 650 \
  --expires 2026-06-12T06:30:00Z \
  --tags pilot-mariner,billing-demo,auto-revoke
```

infra-bot: policy mariner-apac-demo created (edge-policy-9911) in apac-edge-1 (canary).

theo_netops: FW + proxy passthrough configured on apac-proxy-05. Smoke curl to validate header please:

```
curl -I -H "X-Session-ID: smoke-42" https://apac-edge-01.redwood-inference.example/mariner/health
```

maya_cs: running smoke now, will update.

maya_cs: smoke returned 200 OK, header preserved, no 429s in first 9m. Demo lead says initial flows good.

rachel_ops: billing tag added and Grafana panel created. Alert wired to #eng-sre for 429 rate >0.75%. Auto-revoke scheduled.

infra-bot: rollout to apac-edge-2/3 complete. policy edge-policy-9911 active across apac.

vlad_eng: monitoring for 2h post-demo. Plan to reduce burst to 150 and qps to 30 two hours after start, then let auto-expire.

infra-bot: policy edge-policy-9911 auto-revoked at 2026-06-12T06:30:02Z (expiry).

maya_cs: Demo wrapped — customer reported stable behavior and lower latencies. Logging pilot results + customer quote in account_health. We'll follow up in renewal with steady-state uplift request (est. +35% QPS) and include token-cost + caching suggestions. Thanks! :tada:
